page: Amazon Web Services u7in-32tb.224xlarge is an ultra-high memory server instance within the memory-optimized family, powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. Designed for extreme-scale enterprise data platforms, it features an x86_64 Intel processor environment delivering 448 physical cores and 896 dedicated vCPUs with two threads per core operating at a base frequency of 1.9 GHz.

Hardware specifications focus heavily on memory capacity, provisioning 32,768.0 GB (32 TB) of system memory, which equates to 36.57 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance does not include any local NVMe storage and contains zero GPUs. Network capabilities feature a baseline network bandwidth of 200 Gbps, providing substantial throughput to compensate for external network-attached storage architectures and high-volume data ingest.

The qualitative cost profile reflects maximum hardware density within a single system footprint, trading off the absence of integrated local storage for massive centralized memory capacity and high-throughput networking. Workload fit is targeted strictly at massive in-memory databases such as SAP HANA, large-scale transaction processing systems, real-time analytics engines, and in-memory caches that require extreme RAM capacity under a dedicated processing allocation.
